VI.description: Finds a DQMH module's API tester and RT tester on disk with Delacor's own Find Tester on Disk.vi and Find RT Tester on Disk.vi - the two lookups Scripter - Create RT Tester.vi makes before it decides whether to script or to show a modal. A subVI of the headless DQMH wrappers\3B it changes nothing.\0A\0AModules is the 0- or 1-element Selected Modules array of lvdqmh_pick_event.vi\2C so an unfound module simply runs the loop zero times\3A both flags come back FALSE and both paths empty\2C with no call made on an empty library reference. Each path is empty unless its flag is TRUE\3A measured 2026-10-06\2C Find RT Tester on Disk.vi answered RT tester found? FALSE together with the path of an unrelated VI in the module folder.\0A\0AGenerated by LabVIEWMCP\3B the Delacor VIs it calls belong to the user's DQMH installation and are not shipped with it.
